about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.title: Trusted Barcode Label Manufacturing Excellence
about.description: Astrix Glow specializes in designing and manufacturing premium barcode labeling solutions for businesses across retail, logistics, healthcare, manufacturing, and e-commerce sectors. Our commitment to quality, precision, and innovation ensures every label delivers exceptional print clarity, reliable scan performance, and long-term durability. From custom label design to large-scale production, we help brands streamline operations and improve product traceability.

features.title: Industry Expertise
features.text: Serving retail, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare, and e-commerce businesses with specialized barcode labeling solutions tailored to industry requirements.

features.title: Custom Manufacturing
features.text: Flexible production capabilities supporting custom sizes, materials, adhesives, finishes, QR codes, and variable data printing requirements.

features.title: Quality Assurance
features.text: Every label undergoes rigorous quality checks to ensure superior print clarity, durability, adhesion performance, and barcode readability.

features.title: Fast Production & Support
features.text: Efficient manufacturing workflows and dedicated customer support ensure quick turnaround times and reliable delivery schedules.

about.imageAlt: Barcode labels applied to inventory in an automated warehouse center

products.subtitle: OUR PRODUCTS
products.title: Complete Labeling Solutions for Modern Businesses
products.description: From custom barcode labels and asset tracking solutions to industrial-grade labeling systems, Astrix Glow delivers end-to-end labeling products designed to improve product identification, inventory management, and supply chain efficiency.

items.title: Direct Thermal Labels
items.description: Ideal for shipping, logistics, inventory control, and short-term barcode applications requiring reliable scan performance.

items.title: Thermal Transfer Labels
items.description: Designed for demanding environments requiring superior print permanence, durability, and resistance.

items.title: Asset Tracking Labels
items.description: Durable barcode labels designed for machinery, equipment, tools, and inventory asset identification.

items.title: Security & Tamper Labels
items.description: Specialized labels that reveal tampering attempts and provide enhanced product and asset security.

items.title: Warehouse & Logistics Labels
items.description: Barcode labels optimized for warehousing, shipping, receiving, and inventory management operations.

items.title: Custom Printed Labels
items.description: Fully customized barcode and QR code labels tailored to branding, packaging, and operational requirements.

solutions.subtitle: Target Verticals
solutions.title: Engineered Labeling Industry Integrations
solutions.description: Maximize product traceability. Our custom labeling solutions and media integrations target major industry operations.

items.title: Retail Barcode Labeling
items.description: We optimize fast fashion and global luxury retail operations with custom barcode labels. Seamless inventory updates, reduced shrink, and faster restocking improve customer experience.

items.title: Warehouse & Logistics
items.description: Automate logistics from inbound receiving dock gates to outbound shipping bays. Scan and track multiple packages efficiently to ensure seamless workflow synchronization.

items.title: Asset Label Tracking
items.description: Secure IT equipment, medical devices, and manufacturing machinery with rugged barcode labels. Our labels ensure clear identification and easy auditability across enterprise assets.

items.title: Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Solutions
items.description: Ensure accurate identification of medicines, laboratory samples, medical equipment, and patient records with high-precision barcode labels.

services.subtitle: Our Capabilities
services.title: End-to-End Labeling Engineering
services.description: We support you from label media selection and adhesion testing to final software integration and systems validation.

items.title: Application Engineering
items.description: Custom middleware and system software. We connect reader hardware to your ERP database (SAP, Oracle) or WMS platforms via secure REST APIs.

items.title: Label Materials Testing & Validation
items.description: We perform testing for adhesive strength, print durability, and material compatibility. Select custom label media tailored to industrial surfaces and harsh environments.

items.title: Implementation & Consulting
items.description: We execute site-survey diagnostics and RF mapping. We calculate the ideal placement for portal readers to prevent read-rate drops.

caseStudies.title: Smart Warehouse Transformation
caseStudies.description: Delivered 42 high-volume label stations across 5 regional distribution centers, replacing manual handheld counts with printed barcode pallet and carton labels.

caseStudies.title: Retail Chain Inventory Control
caseStudies.description: Rolled out tamper-resistant barcode label programs and self-checkout shelf labels across 120 apparel stores to secure merchandise and improve stock visibility.

caseStudies.title: Sterilization Autoclave Tracking
caseStudies.description: Created durable asset labels and sterilization cycle labels to track sterilization trays and medical equipment lifecycle conditions.
